purpose: Guided positive Catholic doctrine in a coherent order between the Daily Catechism and the full Traditional Catechism reference.

publication_gate.rule: Do not expose learn.faith until every lesson has paragraph-level source-resolved bilingual prose. The 433-question St Pius X corpus is now fully mapped, but several lessons require explicit supplementary traditional/magisterial sources.
publication_gate.note: All 54 lessons now have bilingual source-linked draft prose and exact St Pius X mappings. Publication remains blocked pending final editorial review, source-link verification and deduplication acceptance.

relationship_to_existing.learn.catechism.daily: Daily review and spaced encounter with the existing question bank; not the guided doctrine course.
relationship_to_existing.learn.catechism: Full searchable Traditional Catechism reference and exact Q&A owner.
relationship_to_existing.learn.faith: Guided synthesis only; it references rather than replaces or duplicates the Catechism corpus.
relationship_to_existing.apologetics: Defence against objections; not positive doctrinal instruction.
relationship_to_existing.church-crisis: Contested development, rupture/continuity and authority questions; not baseline doctrine.

source_policy.primary_doctrine: Use the existing Traditional Catechism corpus as the immediate doctrinal reference layer, then resolve substantive prose to original Scripture, councils, catechisms and authoritative Magisterium where available.
source_policy.paragraph_rule: Every substantive published paragraph must carry explicit source support.

lessons.supplementarySourceNeed: St Pius X supplies the doctrine of God and His attributes but not a developed natural-theology demonstration from reason; add Scripture/Vatican I/Thomistic sources for the lesson argument.
lessons.catechismNote: St Pius X gives the attributes and providence of God, not a developed philosophical proof of God's existence.

lessons.supplementarySourceNeed: The 1912 catechism presupposes Revelation more than it systematically defines revelation, inspiration and transmission; supplement with authoritative doctrinal sources.

title.en: Man, original justice and the Fall
title.fr: L’homme, la justice originelle et la Chute

lessons.supplementarySourceNeed: The shorter catechism is very compressed on the Holy Ghost as Person and mission; supplement with Creed/Scripture/catechetical sources.
lessons.supplementNeeded: The 433-question catechism gives Trinitarian identity/procession but little developed pneumatology or Pentecost/ecclesial mission.

title.en: Death, judgment and the resurrection of the body
title.fr: Mort, jugement et résurrection de la chair

lessons.supplementarySourceNeed: The sacramental section directly defines sanctifying and sacramental grace but is not a full treatise on actual grace; supplement accordingly.

title.en: The Holy Sacrifice of the Mass
title.fr: Le Saint Sacrifice de la Messe

lessons.note: Teach doctrine of the Mass; ritual explanation remains Mass Formation.
Teach sacramental doctrine; practical confession flow remains PRAY → Confession.

title.en: Extreme Unction / Anointing of the Sick

lessons.note: Teach sacramental doctrine; preparation and concrete sexual ethics remain with their canonical owners.
lessons.catechismNote: Q409–Q411 are intentionally excluded from the doctrinal core because they concern historical Italian civil-law arrangements.

lessons.supplementarySourceNeed: The catechism covers freedom and commandments but not a full modern moral-theology account of moral law; supplement with authoritative moral theology.
Natural law is not directly developed in the 433-question corpus; requires supplementary doctrinal sources.
lessons.supplementNeeded: The short catechism teaches divine/moral law and commandments but does not give a developed natural-law treatise.

lessons.note: Teach conscience positively; apologetic and crisis disputes remain elsewhere.
lessons.supplementarySourceNeed: Conscience is not directly treated as a standalone doctrine in the 433-question corpus; requires supplementary doctrinal sources.
lessons.supplementNeeded: Conscience as proximate moral judgment and its formation require deeper catechetical/Magisterial sources.

title.en: The First, Second and Third Commandments

lessons.note: Teach the commandments and chastity at doctrinal level; concrete acts remain Sexual Ethics.

title.en: Scandal, cooperation and occasions of sin
title.fr: Scandale, coopération et occasions de péché

lessons.note: Teach moral grammar; concrete case analysis remains with the relevant practical owner.
lessons.supplementarySourceNeed: Scandal and occasions of sin are direct; cooperation with evil is not developed and requires supplementary moral-theology sources.
lessons.supplementNeeded: Scandal and occasions of sin are directly covered; formal/material cooperation with evil needs deeper moral-theology sources.

lessons.note: Teach the Church's authority to establish disciplinary precepts and their enduring principles; explicitly distinguish the 1912 fasting, abstinence and marriage-season discipline from current law.
Teach what prayer is; sustained practice belongs to Spiritual Life.

title.en: The Hail Mary and Marian prayer
title.fr: L’Ave Maria et la prière mariale

lessons.supplementarySourceNeed: The shorter catechism has Marian material but no complete standalone Mariology lesson; supplement from authoritative Marian doctrine.

title.en: The saints, relics and sacred images
title.fr: Les saints, les reliques et les images sacrées

lessons.supplementarySourceNeed: Sacramentals and blessings are not adequately developed in the 433-question corpus; requires supplementary catechetical/liturgical sources.
lessons.supplementNeeded: Relics, sacred things and vows are present, but a proper doctrine of sacramentals/blessings needs deeper catechetical and liturgical sources.

lessons.note: Teach meaning of the liturgical year; temporal logic belongs to Calendar.
lessons.supplementarySourceNeed: The catechism treats Sundays, feasts, fasting and Church precepts, but not the liturgical year as a coherent theology; supplement from liturgical sources.
lessons.supplementNeeded: The short catechism covers feast-day duties and Church precepts, not a full theology/structure of the liturgical year.

title.fr: Croissance dans la sainteté et persévérance

lessons.note: Teach positive doctrine of sanctification; practical rule of life belongs to Spiritual Life.
lessons.supplementarySourceNeed: The corpus supplies virtues and means of sanctification, but a coherent lesson on growth/perseverance needs broader ascetical and doctrinal sources.

title.fr: Se préparer à la mort et à l’éternité

lessons.note: Teach death/judgment/Christian preparation; urgent practical action remains in dedicated guides.

remaining_before_publication: Verify every external source URL and source-to-paragraph fit.
Resolve stronger primary sources where the current registry relies on explanatory or mirror sources.
Run cross-module deduplication against Apologetics, Church Crisis, Mass Formation, Sexual Ethics, Spiritual Life and sacramental Formation.

Build the user-facing runtime only after the sourcing and deduplication gates pass.
